photos.title: M82 Chandra HST Spitzer
photos.description:
Composite of multi-wavelength images of the active galaxy M82 from the three Great Observatories: Hubble Space Telescope, Chandra X-Ray Observatory, and Spitzer Space Telescope. X-ray data recorded by Chandra (courtesy of NASA/CXC/JHU/D.Strickland) appears here in blue; infrared light recorded by Spitzer (courtesy of NASA/JPL-Caltech/C. Engelbracht (University of Arizona)) appears in red; Hubble's observations (courtesy of NASA, ESA, and The Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA)) of hydrogen emission appears in orange, and the bluest visible light appears in yellow-green.

photos.title: Burntwood Quarry: Zones of Theorectical Visibility #10
photos.description:
Zones of Theoretical Visibility is a series of images that form part of larger project documenting the reopening of a small sandstone quarry on the edge of the Peak District National Park, UK. The quarry was reopened in 2014, providing stone for restoration work at the nearby stately home, Chatsworth House.

Zone of Theorectical Visibility is a term I came across in the planning application for the reopening of the quarry. It is a mapping process to help understand the impact such activities will have on the landscape 'views'.

photos.title: Zeche Zollverein, Essen-Stoppenberg
photos.description:
Die heute sichtbaren Anlagen des Schachts XII der Zeche Zollverein in Essen sind die komplett erhaltenen Anlagen einer historischen Kohlezeche. Die Zeche Zollverein war von 1851 bis 1986 in Betrieb und die größte und modernste Steinkohleförderanlage der Welt. Heute ist sie als Industriedenkmal zugleich Sinnbild einer bedeutenden Wirtschaftsepoche und als Architekturdenkmal Ausdruck der Formsprache des Bauhauses. Der Industriekomplex Zeche Zollverein in Essen wurde 2001 in die Welterbeliste der UNESCO eingeschrieben.

In den Anlagen des Schachts XII spiegeln sich die wirtschaftlichen und politischen Umbrüche zur Zeit der Erbauung des Schachts Anfang der 1930er Jahre wider. Die Erfahrungen des kurzen wirtschaftlichen Hochs der 1920er und der Beginn von Globalisierung und Modernisierung fanden künstlerisch durch den Übergang vom Expressionismus zum Kubismus und Funktionalismus Ausdruck. Die Architekten Fritz Schupp und Martin Kremmer schufen in der Architektursprache des Bauhauses eine meisterliche Verbindung von Form und Funktionalität. Indem sie den in zwei Achsen angeordneten Industriekomplex nach Prinzipien der Symmetrie und Geometrie gestalteten, schufen sie ein harmonisches Gesa

photos.title: There will be blood
photos.description:
I remember reading an interview in 2008 with a NATO general about the fact that there would be a major war in Europe. At the time, I considered it to be nonsense.

Today I can no longer do that. The matter seems to be decided and we are being led to a new slaughterhouse.

The principle of "the end justifies the means" has now been again firmly anchored in our minds. Once more, it is not what we do that makes us evil. Therefore, the slaughter of millions can be justified as long as it is done for "good". And the good is what they call "the just peace". A "just peace" is achievable only through war, they continue. For this "just peace" we are morally obligated to mercilessly wipe out "the evil", sacrificing our loved ones and ourselves along the way.

This is madness! There is no such thing as war for peace. There is no justice in killing. It has always and will continue to only cause unimaginable suffering and the destruction of countless human lives.

We need to remember what Karl Popper once said: Let ideas die, not people. 

And also what the Germans said: Never again!

---
